xna-type.name: ContentIdentity
xna-type.summary: Provides properties describing the origin of the game asset, such as the original source file and creation tool. This information is used for error reporting, and by processors that need to determine what directory the asset was originally loaded from.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of ContentIdentity with the specified values.

parameters.parameter: The absolute path to the file name of the asset source.
The name of the digital content creation (DCC) tool that created the asset.
Specific location of the content item within the larger source file. For example, this could be a line number in the file.
